simple_rule_S.rule_zh: 先检查聊天收益与后台、速率、终态代价的联合约束，再按冻结的排序和并列规则选S；不得根据最终测试挑选弱基线。候选包含B4，但B4使用预测器的成本需列明。

deduplication.required_evidence: same effective decision rule, parameters, information, event semantics and executable path; retain alias-to-run mapping
deduplication.zero_margin_note: M-no-calibration is not automatically B3. Only if the final development-frozen B3 margin is zero and all remaining effective settings match can the two share runs.
deduplication.nearest_neighbor_note: If an adapted NN exactly equals an existing rule, retain both labels and adaptation limits but count the same physical run once.
deduplication.budget_rule: Budget uses all nominal labels; any verified equivalence reduces physical run count transparently rather than adding independent evidence.

scenarios.additional_control_reason: P0 showed large cap1 chat benefit and background/rate cost. Preserve this strong simple control even if development-selected S differs; do not rename cap1 as fixed service quota B2-Q.
scenarios.arrival_draft: interactive every 500ms; ten background bursts separated by 10s, three requests per burst separated by 50ms; initial background offset 250ms
scenarios.purpose_zh: 在预定突发混合场景比较在线余量相对固定余量的增量与代价，不按最终结果挑负载。

scenarios.arrival_draft: same request counts and budgets as main; background every 10/3s from 250ms
scenarios.purpose_zh: 固定请求数和预设工作预算，检查突发形状改成平缓后是否仍值得增加复杂度。

scenarios.arrival_draft: interactive every 500ms; one background every 10s from 250ms
scenarios.purpose_zh: 后台较少时检验增量需求；请求数和总预算同时改变，不据此单独识别长度效应。

repetitions_and_order.order_rule: For each scenario and block, all methods replay the same pre-generated trace; rotate or randomize strategy order and balance early/late positions; freeze generated order and seeds before final testing.
repetitions_and_order.precision_note: Five blocks are an initial cost estimate, not proof of sufficient precision. Under the current draft of five continuous criteria each using a two-sided 99% exact sign interval, five paired blocks cannot give a finite distribution-free interval and are exploratory only. Choose 10 or 20 on development-only precision rules before final testing; do not stop final testing when significance appears. Ten or twenty blocks also do not guarantee adequate precision.

original_plan_reference.additional_control_change: This P1 draft adds S_cap1 as one auxiliary main control, making the actual draft 55 main or105 full runs at five blocks; original10 core controls remain.

timing_budget.clock: time.monotonic for client-relative durations; server intervals use server clock only
timing_budget.http_transport_fallback_note: Transport-only backstop measured from HTTP send start; this does not replace or extend the system request deadline measured from planned arrival.
timing_budget.request_termination_rule: earliest applicable event wins: system planned_arrival+180s, transport send_start+360s fallback, or global measurement_origin+280s cutoff. System deadline expiry is timeout; the global cutoff is unfinished when it is the earlier applicable boundary.
timing_budget.budget_exceed_rule: Stop scheduling new runs, preserve current evidence and actual overhead; investigate cleanup/persistence failure before continuation. This budget is not a guarantee that external cleanup always finishes within30s.
timing_budget.reference_scope: Two recent P0 batches, each 100s measurement with their own startup/warmup/drain/idle behavior; reference only, not extrapolation validated for new P1 workloads.

extra_machine_costs.reserve_rounding_rule: ceil(nominal_runs * reserve_fraction), original failed runs always retained

disk_budget.sample_scope: Only the four named completed P0 run directories, recursively sized; no scan of all results.
disk_budget.planning_reason: 10MiB per attempt is a provisional allowance above sampled 2.695-2.765MiB for added decision logs; actual P1 log volume must be checked before final freeze.
disk_budget.overflow_rule: pause new runs and revise budget; never delete or overwrite raw evidence to continue

human_effort.user_instruction_zh: 工时方面，你不用纠结太多，你就正常跑，然后等把成果做出来完之后，补工时的说法。
human_effort.note: Original allocation is a planning estimate. User explicitly deferred human-hour accounting until results exist; do not block current work or G1 on missing human hours. Record machine elapsed time from actual logs and later record real human effort if available; never substitute GPU runtime or invent retrospective effort.

freeze metrics, joint cost limits and interval/sample-size rules
separate calibration/development/final data and freeze input hashes
freeze predictor, B3 constant, M update rule and nearest-neighbor adaptation
freeze S selection/tie rule on development data and later record locked choice before final test
verify any equivalence with explicit run mapping
assign and freeze seeds and balanced run order
validate planned-arrival+180s logical deadline, send-start+360s transport fallback, measurement-origin+280s global cutoff, and persistence cleanup implementation
verify practical device availability and disk capacity for each scheduled batch; keep machine-cost estimates and unknown extras explicit
